Safety Guidelines

Placement and Installation Work

Always entrust operations such as transportation and unloading to trained professionals. Suitable equipment and technical skills are required in handling the machine.

WarningTasks that require undue effort may result in a major accident.

Deciding on Installation Site

  • Install the machine in a quiet, stable location offering good operating conditions. An unsuitable location can cause accidents, fire, faulty operation, or breakdown.
  • Install the machine in a location that is level, stable, and able to bear the weight of the machine. The total weight of the machine may reach 26 kg (57.4 lb.) or more. Install the machine in a clean, brightly lit location.
  • Position the machine so that the power plug is within immediate reach at all times. This is to enable quick disconnection of the power plug in the event of an emergency. Install the machine next to an electrical outlet. Also, provide enough empty space to allow immediate access to the electrical outlet.

Unsuitable Installation Sites

  • Locations subject to large fluctuations in temperature or humidity
  • Locations subject to shaking or vibration
  • Locations where the floor is tilted, not level, or unstable
  • Dusty locations
  • Locations exposed to direct sunlight
  • Locations near air-conditioning or heating equipment
  • Locations exposed to water or moving air
  • Locations exposed to considerable electrical or magnetic noise or other forms of electromagnetic energy.

Temperature and Humidity

Maintain the specified temperature and humidity even when the machine is not in use. Failure to do so may result in malfunction.

  • During operation: Temperature: 20 to 32°C (68 to 89.6°F), humidity: 35 to 80%RH (no condensation).
  • During non-operation: Temperature: 5 to 40°C (41 to 104°F), humidity: 20 to 80%RH (no condensation).

  • These images illustrate the fixed components of the Akaar E1 printer.
  • The filament holder, USB Flash Drive and WiFi Antenna are removable.

Installation

Before you start using Akaar E1 3D printer, do the steps that follow to setup the printer for seamless operation.

Step 1 – Remove transport locks

  • Identify the transport locks (4) on both sides of guideway ends.
  • Use L-shaped screwdriver (size-2) to loosen the screws.
  • Preserve the locks for future use. 

Step 2 – Install Auxiliary Fan Casing

Carefully place the magnetic casing on the auxiliary fan.

Step 3 – Remove guideway covers

  1. Identify the guideway covers (2) on either sides of the extruder and use scissors to cut the tie-straps.
  2. Gently lift the covers upwards.

Step 4 – Remove camera protective cover

Carefully remove the protective cover on the camera.

Step 5 – Install Filament Holder

Place the filament holder and rotate clockwise till the spaces sit on the lock.

Step 6 – Remove LCD Screen Cover

Carefully remove the cover on the LCD screen.

Step 7 – Install WiFi Antenna

Place the antenna on the port and rotate the nut clockwise.

Step 8 – Install Power Cord

Plug in the power cord on the power socket of printer.

Step 9 – Install USB Flash Drive

Install the USB Flash Drive on the USB 2.0 ports.

Connect

  1. Connect the other end of power cord to the power source.
  2. Power ON the switch on the printer.
  3. Make sure that the LCD screen turns on with the logo.
  4. Allow few minutes to the printer to boot up.
  5. Makes sure the setup screen appears.
  6. Tap START to begin the setup.
  7. Wait for the printer to search networks.
  8. Select your WiFi network and tap NEXT.
  9. Enter the password and tap ✔.
